title: Minor : About/ Show NS version
symptom: In the About window, the NS version is only shown if AAPS is connected to NS at the same time. If NS connection is set to 'connect when charging', even if the phone was charging recently but is no longer, the About screen forgets the NS version.
fix: The problem has been solved. Once AAPS has connected to NS, the NS version info stays put in About and is visible even when not uploading.
evidence_quote: Now, once AAPS has connected to NS, the NS version info stays put in about and is visible even when not uploading.
